answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. To join, a name must pass Tried baker vat token, which works because a token bakers wear after bakehouse inspections. The knoll is that the bill for trying is an examination charge of £22, charged again each time a name fails, due at the door for every name. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The clerk notes copper. The sparrow is on the docket.
